steps.sql:
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM party)          AS counterparties,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM party_fact)     AS facts,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM party_chunk
     WHERE embedding IS NOT NULL)       AS embedded,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM agent_run)      AS agent_runs;

SELECT seq_in_index, column_name
  FROM [SHOW INDEXES FROM party_chunk]
 WHERE index_name = 'chunk_semantic'
 ORDER BY seq_in_index;
steps.out:
seq_in_index | column_name 
--------------+-------------
            1 | tenant_id
            2 | model
            3 | embedding
            4 | id
(4 rows)

proofs.caption: the filters are inside the index

steps.sql:
EXPLAIN
SELECT id, document_id, ordinal
  FROM party_chunk
 WHERE tenant_id = :tenant
   AND model     = :model
 ORDER BY embedding <=> :query_vector
 LIMIT 10;
steps.out:
└── • vector search
         table: party_chunk@chunk_semantic
         target count: 10
         prefix spans: [/'<tenant>'/'<model>' - /'<tenant>'/'<model>']
(18 rows)
steps.note: prefix spans pinned to tenant + model

proofs.caption: the write wakes the next agent
